summary_1line: Shveta recounts his past as a righteous king who performed severe austerities but in heaven suffers hunger due to a flaw in his conduct.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged king Shveta crowns his brother Suratha and walks alone into a silent forest to begin severe penance beside a lonely lake.
After ascending to Brahmaloka, the radiant Shveta stands before Brahma pleading to know why unbearable hunger and thirst torment him.
